periods.label: Former assassin, shadow guard and queen
periods.nationality: former Koto state / New Kingdom by marriage

status.marital_status: eventually accepts queen title after Lux wins the two-duel condition

appearance.overview: Black-haired girl in distinctive black clothing, heterochromatic eyes, later academy uniform; carries an alluring smile.

eyes.distinctive: different-colored eyes; purple eye associated with Baptism-enhanced reading

attire.default: black servant/assassin clothing or academy uniform

personality.summary: Devoted, dangerous and newly human in her emotions; wants to remain Lux's weapon but is slowly drawn into ordinary love.
fears: Lux dying because she abandoned her shadow role
desires: be acknowledged as human by him
personality.inner_conflict: She prefers being a hidden concubine/weapon, while Lux insists she stand in the light as a queen.

decision_pattern.style: chooses the path that best protects Lux, even if it denies her public happiness

quote_samples: 我还是一如既往地仰慕着主人。
如果想让我做王后的话，还有一个办法哦。

mannerisms: uses kisses and physical control as tests
habits.daily_routine: guards Lux from shadows when not appearing publicly
quirks: ambushes Lux after he defeats her to ensure he stays alert

preferences.role: shadow protector unless Lux proves he no longer needs that sacrifice

background.upbringing: Born as Koto princess, feared as heartless, then used by the Arcadia Empire as an assassin after her homeland's fall.
formative_events: meeting Lux and being treated as human
background.pre_story: Former enemy-turned-servant whose loyalty became love during the Ouroboros loop.

lux-arcadia.summary: She wants to protect him from shadows; he insists she live as a person and queen.

nokotte-triaden.summary: Noct knows about her shadow protection and often catches awkward scenes.

airi-arcadia.summary: Airi and the guards know of her hidden protection arrangement.

lisharhti-atismata.summary: Suggests Lisha's wedding-night outfit and joins the five-queen group.

secrets: Initially refuses to be queen so she can continue as Lux's unseen protector.
periods.summary: Yatoro's episode centers on her refusal to become queen because she wants to remain Lux's disposable shadow. Lux defeats her in Drag-Ride combat, later wins the full two-duel pact offscreen, and she accepts queen status while continuing to test him.

key_events.summary: Reveals her shadow-guard logic and fights Lux in Drag-Ride and unarmed duels.
Rescues the hostage using Yatogami's stealth during the Hounds suppression battle.
